nodes.text:
Markets will always find reasons to go down be it rate hikes, wars, inflation, or global uncertainty. But history shows us one truth: these are temporary. Over time, markets rise with innovation, growth, and resilience.

📈 Stay focused on the long term, not the noise.

#HMPV
